business_summary: GEOMATEC Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells thin film products in Japan. The company offers anti-reflection and anti-glare, including g.moth, cover panels, and anti-reflective (AR) coatings; optical reflection, transmission, separation and synthesis, such as two-way mirrors, electrode films for electrochromic mirrors, metallic mirrors and high reflectivity coatings, UV cut-off filters and cold mirrors, beam splitters, and dichroic filters (mirrors) and band-pass filters; light shielding products; and laser mirrors, laser beam expanders, and f-theta lenses. It also provides inorganic high-resistance transparent conductive films, and electromagnetic wave shield coatings; transparent conducting electrodes; metal electrodes; and fine-circuit formation and patterning. In addition, the company provides transparent heaters, and metallic flexible thin-film heaters; thin-film flow sensors, and capacitive proximity sensors; water and oil repellents; chemical-resistant, corrosion-resistant and high-hardness; metallization; and decorative films. It operates through online store. The company serves devices, displays and touch screens; semiconductors, electronics, and IOT; railway, aviation, and marine; automotive; public spaces, and transportation infrastructure; stores, offices, and houses; museums and exhibitions; decorations and watches; and medical and healthcare industries. GEOMATEC Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.
